intro.title: Introduction
content: Hello, my name is Bryant Mitchell. I am a student at Universidad Católica Andrés Bello, and I am two semesters away from graduation.
I am an individual with a lot of initiative, great potential for growth, and capable of adapting to any situation and solving problems as they arise.

objectives.title: Objectives
content: I am seeking a high impact company where I can further develop my skills, abilities, and knowledge as a web developer and programmer while completing my degree in Software Engineering. My aim is to ensure the delivery of high-performance software while prioritizing an exceptional user experience.

infinityEnergy.title: Infinity Energy
infinityEnergy.description: A collection of web pages built with React, Tailwind, and other libraries, designed for a solar energy company with a clear, direct message.

briigser.title: Briigser
briigser.description: A GIF search app built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, offering a fast interface to explore a wide variety of animations.

recommendai.title: RecomendAI · What2Watch
recommendai.description: Full-stack movie discovery platform with a machine-learning recommender, community reviews, and an AI assistant built with RAG that only suggests real titles from the catalog.
